Jo Chen (CEO): Quick follow-up from today’s all-hands: sales asked for clear owners + short deadlines for BYOK rotation guidance, VPC/Privatelink checklist, and what audit logs we can export for Private customers. Can owners call out who’s taking these?

Ava (Security): I’ll own the BYOK FAQ + rotation paragraph. Will include staged rotation steps and a short auditor note. ETA: 2034568200 (Fri EOD).

Diego (Platform): I’ll own the audit-export examples and CLI snippets (ndjson, stream-to-SIEM). Default retention proposal: 90d full traces, 365d metadata. ETA: 2034568400 (Mon).

Priya (Legal): I’ll review BYOK wording and confirm DPA language for "EU-only" custody claims. Note: retention >3 years requires Privacy sign-off. ETA review: 2034568600 (Mon afternoon).

Ava (Security): Quick BYOK draft line: "Redwood supports staged BYOK rotation using key aliases and an overlap validation window; incoming requests are accepted by both old and new aliases during validation to avoid downtime."

Diego (Platform): Tech caveat: for HSM/BYOK on Private installs we need VIN/test vectors from customers and a validation window. Also add `--redact-pii` option for exports.

Jo Chen (CEO): Great. Please add owners/deadlines + links to the compliance workspace and post the one-paragraph BYOK blurb in the thread when ready.
